name: Mei Lian Tan
bio:
Mei Lian's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during a university internship at a local racing event in Singapore. Captivated by the energy and precision, she shifted her focus from traditional marketing to the high-octane world of racing. After graduating with a degree in communications, she worked her way up through several smaller teams, honing her skills in brand management, sponsorship acquisition, and digital marketing.

At Prema Racing, Mei Lian is responsible for crafting compelling marketing campaigns that resonate with fans and sponsors alike. She believes in leveraging data-driven insights to optimize marketing strategies and create personalized experiences. Known for her meticulous planning and attention to detail, Mei Lian is committed to elevating Prema Racing's brand presence on a global scale. What sets her apart is her knack for identifying emerging trends and adapting marketing approaches to stay ahead of the curve.

physical.hairStyle: long, straight hair with subtle highlights, usually pulled back into a neat ponytail during race weekends
physical.description: Mei Lian has a warm smile and a focused gaze, often seen sporting stylish, yet practical attire.

quirks: Always carries a lucky charm – a miniature race car – on her keychain.
Insists on starting every campaign with a brainstorming session involving all team members.
Has a habit of color-coding her notes with specific Sharpies.
